symptom: `mxcli playwright check <secured page>` with no session waited out the whole --wait (33s at --wait 30s, 8s at 5s) and printed `WAIT not settled … still waiting for POST /xas/` and `FAIL still loading … (raise --wait if it is only slow)` on top of `FAIL the sign-in form is showing`
cause: The probe's settle loop requires no same-origin request open for 500ms (#845), and the client keeps a POST /xas/ open behind the sign-in form (measured on 11.13.0 and 11.15.0), so the page never settled; EvaluatePage then added the still-loading failure for an Unsettled page whatever it showed
insight: A settle condition added for one kind of page (#845's list view whose only loading sign is an open POST /xas/) becomes a wait on every page that holds a request open for another reason — and the sign-in form does, indefinitely. Exempt the state that is a verdict in itself: once #usernameInput is up, settle on text and busy indicators alone. And keep remedies apart in the verdict: 'raise --wait' next to 'sign in' sends the user to the wrong knob. The fake-server harness (probeOrSkip) reproduces it in 20s against 2s fixed, so the test is cheap; the live runs on 11.13 and 11.15 (33s → 3s, exit 1 both ways) are the control for the real client.
